title: MysticChat
description:
Chat mod for lazy people or slow typers, designed for MysticMC, but can be modified for any server.
Designed for MysticMC, but can be modified for any server.
body:
A useful chat mod designed for MysticMC, but can be tweaked freely to fit other servers.
Key features:
- Welcome messages
  - Includes the username of the most recently joined player.
- Dedicated DM chat
  - Allows you to switch to DM mode with a targetted user, so you dont accidentally forget /msg or send it the the wrong user.
- Chat and command macros
  - Options to set a keybind, but not required. Perfect for players with many mods that require keybinds.
- Moveable and resizable HUD
  - Doesn't clutter the screen, as the HUD only shows when chat is opened.
- Quicker teleporting between worlds.
  - Quick rtp button that types the full command for you.
